command: cat src/inventory/stock.py; echo '---TESTS---'; cat tests/test_stock.py; echo '---CONFTEST---'; cat tests/conftest.py; echo '---CHANGELOG---'; cat CHANGELOG.md; echo '---PYPROJECT---'; cat pyproject.toml; echo '---README---'; cat README.md; echo '---TODO---'; cat TODO.md

cat .gnomon/system.md; echo '---CONFIG---'; cat .gnomon/config.toml; echo '---POLICY---'; cat .gnomon/policy.toml; echo '---ROLES---'; cat .gnomon/roles.toml; echo '---TOOLS---'; cat .gnomon/tools.toml; echo '---SKILLS---'; for f in .gnomon/skills/*.md; do echo "### $f"; cat "$f"; done

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

changelog = Path("CHANGELOG.md")
text = changelog.read_text()
old = "# Changelog\n\n## 0.4.0"
new = "# Changelog\n\n## Unreleased\n- Add `Stock.restock(sku, qty)`, which adds a positive quantity and returns the new level.\n\n## 0.4.0"
assert text.count(old) == 1, "unexpected CHANGELOG layout"
changelog.write_text(text.replace(old, new))

pyproject = Path("pyproject.toml")
text = pyproject.read_text()
old = 'version = "0.4.0"'
new = 'version = "0.5.0"'
assert text.count(old) == 1, "unexpected pyproject layout"
pyproject.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
print("updated CHANGELOG.md and pyproject.toml")
PY
cat CHANGELOG.md; echo '---'; cat pyproject.toml; echo '---'; cat src/inventory/stock.py
git diff --stat && git diff -- tests/test_stock.py src/inventory/stock.py CHANGELOG.md pyproject.toml
